title: Validation checks of a module (validation by observation, nest/common/README.md)
description: <module>/validation/checks.json: the behaviours the dev/preprod traces must show. Read by template/scripts/validation-report.mjs (which validates every file against this schema) and, for the traces of the front, by ValidationCheckRegistry.

id.description: Unique across the project, prefixed by the module: `user.login.otp-required`.

module.description: Id of the module owning the file.

scenario.description: How the case arises in real use (what a user or a job does).

traces.description: Trace names (`vtrace` check argument) evidencing the behaviour; any of them with `outcome` makes the check OBSERVED_OK, any of them with `violation` makes it VIOLATION.

mustNotHappen.description: `<trace>` or `<trace>:<outcome>`: one occurrence makes the check VIOLATION.

sources.description: Who emits its traces (default ["back"]). `front` allow-lists them on POST /api/v1/validation/trace.

preLogin.description: Front traces sent before sign-in (unauthenticated route); requires `front` in `sources`.
